parameters.content:
## Report intake and validation

The Telegram bot receives the teacher notes, normalizes the child, class and notes fields, and answers incomplete messages while logging them to Google Sheets.

## Roster matching

The child is matched against the Google Sheets roster. Reports for unknown children alert the director on Telegram and by email and are logged for follow up.

nodes.name: Sticky Note: AI summary and delivery

parameters.content:
## AI parent summary and delivery

A DeepSeek agent writes a warm, parent-friendly summary with concern and follow-up flags. The report is logged to Google Sheets, emailed to the parent and confirmed to the teacher.

## Error handling and director alerts

Unparsable AI output and processing errors are logged and reported, and anything flagged as a concern or follow-up goes to the director on Telegram and by email.

## Daily missing report sweep

Every evening the roster is compared with the reports logged today, and children without a report are chased on Telegram and by email.

## Weekly parent digest

On Friday the week of reports is summarized, an AI agent writes the parent digest, and it is emailed to families and posted on Telegram.

## Send childcare daily reports and director digests with Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets and DeepSeek

### How it works

1. Teachers send the day's notes for a child to a Telegram bot.
2. The message is validated, the child is matched against the Google Sheets roster, and unknown children raise a director alert.
3. A DeepSeek agent turns the notes into a short, parent-friendly summary with concern and follow-up flags.
4. The report is logged to Google Sheets and emailed to the parent, and the teacher gets a confirmation.
5. Flagged reports, processing errors and unparsable AI output alert the director on Telegram and by email.
6. Every evening children without a report are reminded on Telegram and by email, and every Friday an AI-written weekly digest is emailed to parents and posted on Telegram.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a Telegram bot with BotFather and connect the Telegram credential
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets and create a Roster tab and a DailyReports tab with matching columns
- [ ] Connect an OpenAI credential for the summary and digest agents
- [ ] Connect Gmail and set the director and parent sender addresses plus the director Telegram chat ID
- [ ] Adjust the daily sweep and Friday digest schedules to your timezone

### Customization

Change the AI summary prompt, add meal or nap templates for teachers, or swap the Telegram trigger for a classroom form if your staff prefer typing in a browser.
